language.name: English
frame.label: Sign up and find work
check.voice_pending: You have voice answers waiting for confirmation. Please check them before you send.
done.referral_body: Your request is now in {org}'s list. Their staff will contact you to help verify your identity.
text_size.label: Text size
read_aloud.unavailable: Read aloud isn't available in {language} on this device yet.
read_aloud.notice: Read aloud is on. Press any key or tap anywhere to start listening. You can turn it off in the Accessibility menu.
read_aloud.tab_hint: Press Tab to go from one item to the next.
speech.answer_in_box: Your answer is in the box.
speech.answer_on_screen: Your answer is on the screen.
speech.hint.type: Type your answer, then press Enter.
speech.hint.type_long: Type your answer. Then press Tab to move on.
speech.hint.arrows: Use the up and down arrow keys to choose.
speech.hint.checkbox: Press Space to tick or untick it.
speech.hint.file: Press Enter to choose a photo.
speech.hint.error_link: Press Enter to go to the question.
status.offline: You are offline. Your answers are saved on this phone.
status.waking: Connecting to the service. The first time, this can take up to a minute.
save_panel.title: Save and finish later
save_panel.explanation: Your answers are saved on this phone as you go. You can close this window and come back later on this phone.
save_panel.forget_explanation: If this is a shared or public phone, you can delete your answers from this device.
save_panel.forget_confirm: Are you sure? This will delete all your answers saved on this phone.
save_panel.forgot_done: Your saved answers were deleted from this phone.
save_panel.profile_explanation: Your profile page shows what we keep about you. You can change it or delete it there.
save_panel.continue_explanation: Get a link and a 6-character code to continue your sign-up on another phone or computer.
resume.title: Continue with a code
resume.explanation: Type the code you got. A 6-character code continues a sign-up you started. Your 8-character sign-in code opens your profile if you have finished signing up.
resume.code_hint: Letters and numbers, like ABC-123 (6) or ABCD-1234 (8).
resume.phone_hint: Enter the last 4 digits of the phone number you used.
resume.dob_hint: Enter your date of birth to confirm it's you.
resume.success_sign_in: Welcome back! You are signed in.
resume.continue_existing: Already started or signed up? Continue with a code
help_panel.title: Get help from a person
help_panel.intro: If you need assistance, you can reach out through any of these channels:
help_panel.none: Help contacts are not available right now. Please try again later.
help_panel.call_hint: Press Tab to reach the Call support button. On a phone, it opens your phone app with the number filled in.
language_screen.title: Choose your language and mode
language_screen.hint: Select the language you prefer. You can also turn on Simple mode for larger text.
language_screen.note: You don't need any documents to start. You can stop at any time.
voice.didnt_catch: Didn't catch that. Please try again or type instead.
voice.consent_body: To turn your voice into text, it is sent to a speech service on the internet: the one your browser uses (for example Google in Chrome, Microsoft in Edge) or the one our server uses. We don't keep recordings. If you choose “Use another way”, your voice is recorded on this device and turned into text on our own server only.
voice.mic_help_body: Your browser blocked the microphone or no microphone was found. You can allow microphone access in your browser settings, use your phone keyboard microphone, or type your answer.
voice.mock_note: Test voice service: this is sample text, not what you said.
voice.name_check: Names are often heard wrong. Check it. You can say it again or type it.
voice.no_choice_match: We didn't catch which option you meant. Say it again, or choose it.
errors.too_short: This is too short. Please write a little more.
errors.too_long: This is too long. Please write less.
errors.date_invalid: Enter a real date, for example 15 Meskerem 2010.
errors.date_incomplete: Enter the day, the month and the year.
errors.date_future: Your date of birth can't be in the future.
errors.date_past: The date can't be in the past.
errors.unknown_question: Something went wrong with this question. Please go back and try again.
errors.answer_conflict: This answer was changed on your other device.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.payload_too_large: The recording is too long. Please say a shorter answer.
errors.unsupported_audio: We couldn't use that recording. Please try again.
errors.speech_unavailable: We couldn't turn your voice into text right now. Please type your answer, or try again later.
errors.sms_unavailable: We can't send SMS right now. Please try again later.
errors.resume_check_failed: That didn't match. Please check and try again.
errors.resume_expired: This link has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.not_implemented: This part is not ready yet.
errors.network: You seem to be offline. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.options_unavailable: We couldn't load this list. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.validation_failed: Some answers need to be checked.
errors.invalid: This answer is not right. Please check it.
errors.email_invalid: Enter an email address like name@example.org.
errors.invalid_request: Something went wrong with this request. Please try again.
errors.unknown_step: Something went wrong with this question. Please go back and try again.
errors.already_applied: You already applied for this job.
errors.apply_not_registered: Finish signing up before you apply for a job.
errors.speech_unclear: We didn't catch that. Please try again or type instead.
errors.publish_failed: The job is saved as a draft, but we couldn't publish it. Use Publish in your job list.
errors.partner_key_missing: This website has not set up the form correctly (partner key missing).
errors.partner_key_invalid: This website has not set up the form correctly (unknown partner key).
errors.origin_not_allowed: This form can't be used on this website.
errors.resume_not_found: We couldn't find that code. Please check it and try again.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many tries. Please wait and try again later.
errors.last4_invalid: Type exactly 4 letters or numbers, for example 4821 or AB12.
errors.file_invalid: We couldn't use that file. Please choose a photo.
errors.file_too_large: That photo is too big. Please choose a smaller one.
signup.welcome.title: Sign up to learn with us
signup.welcome.hint: We will ask one question at a time. You can stop and come back. Your answers are saved as you go. You don't need any documents to start.
signup.consent_data.title: How we use your answers
signup.consent_data.hint: We keep your answers to set up your learning account. You can see, change or delete your data at any time on your profile page.
signup.full_name.title: What is your full name?
signup.full_name.hint: Your name, your father's name and your grandfather's name. For example: Abebe Kebede Tesfaye.
signup.preferred_name.title: What should we call you?
signup.preferred_name.hint: For example a short name. You can skip this.
signup.contact_method.title: How can we reach you?
signup.contact_method.partner: Through an organisation that helps me
signup.contact_method.none: I don't want to be contacted
signup.phone.title: What is your phone number?
signup.dob.title: When were you born?
signup.dob.hint: For example 15 Meskerem 2010. You can skip this.
signup.sex.title: What is your sex?
signup.sex.hint: This helps programmes for women and for men reach you. You can skip this.
signup.region.title: Where do you live?
signup.region.hint: Choose your region or city. You can skip this.
signup.education.title: What is the highest level of school you finished?
signup.education.hint: This helps match you with jobs and courses. You can skip this.
signup.education.none: I did not go to school
signup.id_route.title: Which of these do you have?
signup.id_route.hint: You can still sign up if you have none of these.
signup.id_route.none: I have none of these. Refer me through an organisation.
signup.id_doc_type.title: Which document do you have?
signup.id_doc_type.hint: Just choose the type of document.
signup.id_upload.title: Add a photo of your document
signup.id_upload.hint: This is optional. The photo is stored encrypted, and nobody checks it automatically. Take a photo or choose one from your phone, or skip this question.
signup.id_last4.title: What are the last 4 letters or numbers on it?
signup.id_last4.hint: This is optional, and it is not an ID check. If you meet staff later, it helps them find your document. If your document has no number, skip this.
signup.referral_partner.title: Which organisation can help you?
signup.referral_partner.hint: Their staff will see your request and contact you.
signup.referral_partner.empty: We can't show the organisations right now. Try again, go back and choose another way, or ask a person for help.
signup.referral_contact.title: How should they contact you?
signup.support_needs.title: What would help you?
signup.support_needs.hint: Choose any that help you learn or work. You don't need to explain why. You can skip this.
signup.support_other.title: Is there anything else that would help?
signup.support_other.hint: Say it or type it. You can skip this.
signup.support_share.title: Who can see what would help you?
signup.support_share.hint: Our support team may read it to help you. Choose who else may see it. Before an employer sees it, we ask you again when you apply for a job.
signup.support_share.employers: Employers when I apply for a job
signup.check.title: Check your answers
signup.done.title: You are signed up
signup.done.hint: Your sign-up is complete. You can now look for jobs. You can see or change your details on your profile page.
signup.done.referred_hint: Your details are registered. While {org} helps verify your identity, you can explore available jobs and manage your profile.
needs.screen_reader.learner: I use a screen reader or need things read aloud
needs.screen_reader.employer: Tools and documents work with screen readers
needs.large_text.learner: I need large text or magnification
needs.sign_language.learner: I need a sign language interpreter
needs.sign_language.employer: Sign language interpreter for interviews and meetings
needs.captions.learner: I need captions or written notes
needs.captions.employer: Captions and written notes for meetings
needs.flexible_hours.learner: I need flexible hours or breaks
needs.remote_work.learner: I need to work or study from home
needs.extra_time.learner: I need extra time for tests and tasks
needs.extra_time.employer: Extra time for tests and tasks
needs.written_instructions.learner: I need instructions in writing, in simple words
needs.quiet_space.learner: I need a quiet place to work
needs.own_device.learner: I need to use my own device or software
needs.own_device.employer: You may use your own assistive device or software
needs.person_to_help.learner: I need a person to help me
needs.person_to_help.employer: A named support person or mentor
jobs.title: Find a job
jobs.result_count: {count} jobs offer all {needs} supports you chose
jobs.result_count_one: {count} jobs offer the support you chose
jobs.none: There are no jobs right now. Please come back later.
jobs.filter_hint: Choose the supports you need. Jobs are matched on this device only: your choices are not sent anywhere.
application.contact_confirm.title: Are these contact details right?
application.motivation.title: Why do you want this job?
application.motivation.hint: Say it or type it, in your own words.
application.start_date.title: When can you start?
application.attach_support.title: Do you want to ask this employer for the support you need?
application.attach_support.hint: If you choose Yes, this employer will see the supports you told us would help you, so they can prepare them. If you choose No, they won't see them. You can change this at any time on My profile.
application.check.title: Check your application
application.done.title: Your application was sent
apply.signup_first_body: To apply for this job, finish signing up first. It takes a few minutes. Then you can come back to this job.
apply.contact_change_note: If these details are not right, you can change them on your profile page.
profile.title: My profile
profile.intro: This is what we keep about you. You can change it or delete it.
profile.language.title: Which language do you want to use?
profile.simple_mode.title: Do you want to use Simple mode?
profile.simple_mode.hint: Simple mode makes the text a little larger.
profile.label.identity_level: How we know who you are
profile.label.support_share: Who can see what would help you
profile.verify_phone_body: This is optional. We send a 6-digit code by SMS to your phone. Typing it here shows that this number is yours.
profile.verify_phone_sent: We sent a code to {phone}. It works for 10 minutes.
profile.verify_phone_wrong: That code doesn't match or has expired. Check the SMS or ask for a new code.
profile.verify_phone_required: Type the 6-digit code from the SMS.
profile.verify_phone_wait: Please wait a minute before asking for a new code.
profile.verify_phone_not_supported: For now we can only send SMS to Ethio Telecom numbers (09…).
profile.passport_title: Employers who can see what would help me
profile.passport_intro: You told us once what would help you. Choose which employers can see it. You can stop sharing at any time.
profile.passport_none: You haven't applied for a job yet. When you apply, you choose if that employer can see what would help you.
profile.passport_no_needs: You haven't told us what would help you yet, so there is nothing to share.
profile.passport_shared: Can see what would help you
profile.passport_not_shared: Can't see what would help you
profile.passport_now_shared: {employer} can now see what would help you.
profile.passport_now_stopped: {employer} can no longer see what would help you.
profile.level.partner_attested: A partner organisation vouched for you
profile.level.verified: A trained person checked your document
profile.referral_status.requested: Your request is in their list
profile.vouch_body: If {partner} met you or called you, they can give you a 6-digit code. Type it here to confirm who you are. You don't need an ID.
profile.vouch_wrong: That code doesn't match. Check it with {partner} and try again.
profile.vouch_expired: This code has expired. Ask {partner} for a new one.
profile.none_title: We can't find your details on this device
profile.none_body: Your profile belongs to the sign-up made on this device, and there is none here. If you signed up on another phone or computer, use your sign-in code to open your profile here.
profile.draft_body: Your answers so far are saved. Finish signing up to change your details here.
profile.export_body: You can download a copy of all the personal information, answers, and choices you have saved with us as a JSON file.
profile.delete_body: This deletes your sign-up, your answers, what would help you, your requests to organisations and your job applications. It can't be undone.
profile.delete_confirm_body: We will delete everything we keep about you on our server, and your answers saved on this device. This can't be undone. To use the service again, you would need to sign up again.
profile.deleted_body: We deleted everything we kept about you on our server, and your answers on this device. You can sign up again at any time.
employer.title.title: What is the job title?
employer.description.title: Describe the job
employer.description.hint: Use simple words. Say what the person will do each day.
employer.location_type.title: Where will the person work?
employer.location_type.hybrid: Some days at home, some at our workplace
employer.location_text.title: Which town or city?
employer.work_hours.title: What are the working hours?
employer.work_hours.hint: For example Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00
employer.employment_type.title: What kind of job is it?
employer.accommodations.title: Which supports (accommodations) does this job offer?
employer.accommodations.hint: Choose every support you can give. Applicants filter jobs by these.
employer.check.title: Check the job
employer.done.title: The job is published
staff.title: Staff sign-in
staff.create_job: Post a job and the supports it offers (accommodations form)
staff.missing_fields: Enter your email address and password.
staff.login_failed: The email address or password is not right.
staff.not_employer: This page is for employers and partner staff. You are signed in as: {role}.
staff.job_form_intro: Describe the job, then choose the supports (accommodations) it offers. People looking for work filter jobs by these supports.
staff.support_shared_note: The applicant chose to share this with you.
staff.referrals_intro: These people chose your organisation when they signed up. Contact them the way they asked, then mark it done.
staff.no_referrals: Nobody has asked for help yet.
staff.referral_status.requested: Waiting for you to contact them
staff.referral_status.attested: Confirmed: your organisation vouched for them
staff.identity_level.partner_attested: Confirmed by a partner organisation that met them
staff.vouch_body: Only vouch for someone you have met or spoken with. Employers and learning platforms will see that your organisation confirmed who this person is. You then tell them a one-time code: when they type it on their profile, they agree.
staff.vouch_check: I met or spoke with {name} and I confirm who they are.
staff.vouch_check_required: Tick the box first: you can only vouch for someone you met or spoke with.
staff.vouch_code_help: Tell this code to {name}. They type it on their profile, under "Confirm who you are". It works once, until {time} (30 minutes).
signin_code.title: Your sign-in code
signin_code.body: Keep this code safe, for example write it down. To open your profile on another phone, or after "Forget me on this phone", choose "Continue with a code" and type it. We also ask your date of birth or the last 4 digits of your phone.
signin_code.label: Sign-in code
signin_code.not_ready: Your code will be ready when your sign-up has reached us. Try again when you are online.
signin_code.error: We could not get your code just now.
signin_code.new_hint: Do this if someone else may have seen your code. The old code stops working.
signin_code.new_done: Your new code is ready. The old code no longer works.
